north_star: A huge, machine-readable hub of all AI knowledge that also improves existing skills, integrates new parts, and tests better versions.

lanes.name: Deep analysis (Claude, night-gated)
lanes.improve_note: Highest quality, reserved for curation/self-improve (not bulk) to protect the small Pro budget — night-gated by design. The free pool carries the volume.

lanes.name: Tool discovery (off-playlist)
lanes.improve_note: Finds tools beyond the playlist 3x/week. Next lever: move it to the free engine pool to save the Pro budget (currently uses the Claude token).

lanes.name: Channel/source suggestion
lanes.improve_note: Proposes new channels daily (1 pending). One-time OAuth would let it auto-add to the playlist (else suggestions only — surfaced on the Grow Sources tab).

lanes.name: Transcript backfill — residential (optional turbo)
lanes.improve_note: Recovers ~85% of caption-less videos fast from a home IP (coverage 10.7%) + translates foreign captions. No longer required — Supadata is the unattended baseline; this is the turbo when we're in a session. Block-aware (auto-stops on the escalating IP block).

lanes.name: Transcript fetch — Supadata (cloud, UNATTENDED)
lanes.improve_note: PROVEN working & PC-FREE (the autonomy baseline): fetches on Supadata's infra so the datacenter-IP block doesn't apply; daily, dead-video skip protects the ~100/mo free quota (14 recovered). Lever: the quota caps backlog speed, not new videos.

lanes.name: Free analysis lane (bulk_analyze)
lanes.improve_note: Turns transcripts into records at 0 Claude cost via 4 VERIFIED engines (gpt-4.1-mini, OpenRouter, Groq, Gemini; pool auto-drops failures). Library avg quality 3.75/10, 3% low-source. Output is externally consumable via data/hub.json.

lanes.name: Web AI news (95 sources)
lanes.improve_note: Always-on (every 6h), 95 RSS sources across labs, research (arXiv/BAIR/MIT), community (Reddit/HN) and top analysts; 6925 items stored. Dead feeds auto-prune.

summary.top_improvement: Highest quality, reserved for curation/self-improve (not bulk) to protect the small Pro budget — night-gated by design. The free pool carries the volume.
